gameName: Hegemony: Lead Your Class to Victory

provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Hegemony rules summary (Hegemonic Project Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: 4 starting Capitalist Companies (Supermarket, Shopping Mall, College, Clinic) with L2 Wage markers
3 starting Public Companies in the first Public Sector row with L2 Wage markers; a facedown card of each type in row two, the other 3 facedown in row three
2 starting Middle Class Companies (Convenience Store, Doctor's Office) with L2 Wage markers
Shuffle the Business Deal, Export and Immigration decks; Export marker on the middle Import space
Policy markers: Policies 1-5 in mixed starting positions, 6-7 as set
120 in the State Treasury; Public Services Health/Education/Influence: {n}
Round marker on 1, Tax Multiplier on 5, scoring markers on 0
Voting cubes in 3 piles by color; 8 of each color in the bag (all 3 colors even with 2 players)
Working Class: Population 10, Prosperity 0, 30 money, 1 Influence, 3 red Bill markers; draw 7 Action cards; 2 Cooperative Farm cards aside; place starting Workers

Capitalist Class: 120 in Revenue; 1 Food, 2 Luxury, 2 Education, 1 Influence in Storage (Food price 12, others 8); Free Trade Zone; 3 blue Bill markers; draw 7 Action cards; reveal 4 Companies as your Market
Middle Class: Population 10, Prosperity 0, 40 money, 1 Influence; 1 Food and 1 Health (Food price 12, others 8); 3 yellow Bill markers; draw 7 Action cards; reveal 3 Companies; place starting Workers
State: a marker on the second space of each Legitimacy track; 1 Influence; 3 gray Bill markers; draw 7 Action cards; 2 Event cards faceup; top Political Agenda card; Health Welfare tile
The Preparation Phase is skipped in round 1
Round 1 starts with the Action Phase
